title: End-to-End Pipeline Test
testScenario: Full pipeline simulation: evidence upload → agency detection → event extraction → policy matching → compliance analysis → report generation → 3D reconstruction → timeline → expert package

pipelineSteps.name: Evidence Upload
pipelineSteps.description: Upload bodycam video, audio transcript, and incident report for a simulated use-of-force case
pipelineSteps.notes: Supports bodycam, dashcam, audio, and document source types

pipelineSteps.name: Agency Detection
pipelineSteps.description: Identify the law enforcement agency from case metadata and match to agency registry
pipelineSteps.notes: Searches by name, county, or ORI number

pipelineSteps.name: Event Extraction
pipelineSteps.description: Extract timestamped events from evidence — speech analysis, video action detection, officer timeline
pipelineSteps.notes: Extracts use_of_force, verbal_command, weapon_draw, pursuit, de_escalation, search, arrest, miranda events

pipelineSteps.name: Policy Matching
pipelineSteps.description: Match detected actions to applicable policy rules for the identified agency
pipelineSteps.notes: Maps event types to rules via PolicyActionMapping with relevance scores

pipelineSteps.name: Compliance Analysis
pipelineSteps.description: Evaluate events against matched policies, generate findings with confidence scores and safety language
pipelineSteps.notes: All findings use 'potential_policy_inconsistency' language. Minimum confidence threshold: 0.40

pipelineSteps.name: Report Generation
pipelineSteps.description: Generate compliance report with findings, evidence links, and audit trail
pipelineSteps.notes: Report includes finding summaries, evidence links, review status, and safety guardrail verification

pipelineSteps.name: 3D Scene Reconstruction
pipelineSteps.description: Build 3D scene geometry from incident location data, including buildings, roads, vehicles, terrain
pipelineSteps.notes: Generates mesh data for buildings, roads, sidewalks, vehicles, vegetation, obstacles, and terrain

pipelineSteps.name: Bodycam Vision Analysis
pipelineSteps.description: Analyze bodycam footage for pose estimation, object detection, temporal tracking
pipelineSteps.notes: Simulated vision model — generates realistic vision events for development/testing

pipelineSteps.name: Trajectory Analysis
pipelineSteps.description: Compute bullet/projectile trajectories, impact angles, line-of-fire vectors
pipelineSteps.notes: Supports 6 weapon profiles: Glock 17, Glock 22, SIG P320, AR-15, Remington 870, TASER X26

pipelineSteps.name: Timeline Production
pipelineSteps.description: Generate unified event timeline combining all evidence sources with playback controls
pipelineSteps.notes: Aggregates vision events, trajectory data, visibility conditions, and compliance findings into chronological timeline

pipelineSteps.name: Evidence Graph Construction
pipelineSteps.description: Build unified evidence graph with nodes and edges linking all evidence types
pipelineSteps.notes: 11 node types, 9 edge types, automatic clustering and timeline generation

pipelineSteps.name: Expert Witness Package Export
pipelineSteps.description: Generate structured expert witness package with 3D scene, timeline, policy analysis, evidence clips
pipelineSteps.notes: Uses 'potential_policy_inconsistency' language throughout. Includes appendices and analysis report.

warnings: Vision analysis uses simulated model — production deployment will need actual ML model integration
Speech analysis uses simulated transcription — production will need Whisper or equivalent
OCR pipeline requires Tesseract or equivalent to be installed on production server
3D scene reconstruction uses procedural generation — production may integrate actual LIDAR/aerial imagery

recommendedActions: Integrate production ML models for vision analysis
Set up file storage (S3/R2) for evidence documents
Run with real case data to validate end-to-end flow
